name: Phil Clunies-Ross
story: Phil Clunies-Ross presented a lightning talk at FOSS4G Auckland in November 2025 about Delinify, a reporting tool he had recently built using open source and AI. The conference record documents a public demonstration; it does not describe organisational deployment or ongoing maintenance. The example places AI-assisted spatial reporting among the tools practitioners were exploring at the end of 2025.
